name: Tofoo Naked Tofu (organic, nigari, 280 g)
note: Label per 100 g: 145 kcal, protein 16.5 g, fat 7.8 g (sat 1.2 g), carb 1.1 g, fibre 1.9 g, salt 0.06 g (Na 24 mg). Ingredients: water, soya beans (36%), nigari (magnesium chloride) – NOT calcium-set, so far less calcium than calcium-set tofu. NOT on label, ESTIMATED from the Japanese tables 2023, 04097 firm (momen) tofu made with magnesium chloride, scaled to 16.5 g protein (×2.36): phosphorus 207, potassium 259, calcium 94, magnesium 179 mg, Fe, Zn, Cu, Mn, I, Se. Vitamins, amino acids and linoleic acid from 'Tofu, firm (calcium-set)' scaled to 16.5 g protein. Water by difference. Oxalate: OHF 2024 (tofu); varies by brand. Vegan. The Tofoo Co., Malton.
